findings.reason: a §4 node reading "every certificate rung" would either fail unachievable coarse-rung rows or must be told the clause bounds the analytic certificate only, and the plan does not say which.
findings.text: §4's done-when bounds the map at "≤1e-2 relative sup at every certificate rung in exact mode for both cases", but §6's acceptance rows keep the centroid-constrained certificate at weak/moderate/strong 110, 300 and 1000 cells (plus single-null 500), and the design document's map-fidelity clause applies to "Analytic/centroid rows"; the cited exact-support decomposition shows the map sup is 0.0712 at 132 cells and 0.0187 at 550 cells, both above 1e-2, so the gate as written is unsatisfiable at the coarse centroid rungs while the plan retains them

rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach the s3/s4 prose or the new symbols (`current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`).
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §4's map-fidelity gate bounds the map at ≤1e-2 relative sup "at every certificate rung", but the design's own clause applies that bound to the centroid-constrained certificate rows, whose coarse rungs cannot meet it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3 owns `current.book` (one deliverable, the exact-clip booking) and §4 owns `gs.apply` (one deliverable, the map and its derivative); each node closes on one verdict.
